notes: No changes required. Existing stories already meet schema/contract, core logic, API, tests, and integration coverage without duplication.

stories.title: Define Consent Schema and Edge Case Contract
stories.description: Audit and correct the Pydantic consent models and domain schema to fully represent two-tier HIPAA consent, including explicit handling for partial consent, revoked consent, and missing user responses.

stories.title: Fix Two-Tier Consent Logic and State Transitions
stories.description: Correct defects in ConsentService to ensure proper progression between Tier 1 and Tier 2 consent, including handling retries, invalid transitions, and ensuring de-identification is enforced when Tier 2 is not granted.

stories.title: Expose Corrected Consent Behavior via API and Tool Router
stories.description: Ensure corrected consent logic is properly surfaced through FastAPI endpoints and tool_router interactions, including consistent responses for consent prompts, failures, and state persistence across chat turns.

stories.title: Consent Flow Unit and Edge Case Test Suite
stories.description: Implement unit tests covering consent tier transitions, denial paths, repeated prompts, and de-identification enforcement, including regression tests for previously observed defects.

stories.title: Integrate Consent Fixes with Lead Capture and Unknown Question Flows
stories.description: Validate and correct integration points where consent is invoked in lead_capture_service and unknown_question_service, ensuring consistent consent enforcement and no leakage of identifiable data without Tier 2 approval.
